sources.title: College of New Caledonia Statement of Financial Information 2018/19 — complete named employee schedule
sources.periodEvidence: Employee schedule header explicitly reads APRIL 1, 2018 TO MARCH 31, 2019; all accepted physical pages visually reviewed.
sources.publicWarning: Source remuneration can include taxable benefits and other payments; expenses remain separate. The source-labelled named schedule includes some remuneration below $75,000. Displayed cells and documented subtotal differences are preserved. Existing compiled observations remain available.
notes: Other Employees schedule only. Board, supplier, below-threshold aggregates and reconciliation lines are excluded. Positions are not published for this cohort.

Source defines remuneration as any form of salary, wages, bonuses, gratuities, taxable benefits, payments into trust or income deferral paid to/on behalf of the employee during the fiscal year; severance-agreement amounts are excluded.
Source expenses include amounts paid on College purchasing cards on behalf of employees. Dashes and blanks remain null, distinct from explicit numeric zero.
Displayed employee rows minus printed named subtotal: remuneration -5 CAD; known expenses -1 CAD. No cells were altered to balance controls.
Two separately segmented Tesseract readings were compared; every row was checked against original rendered pixels. Both OCR passes use the same engine.
The current official index no longer links 2018/19; the supplied official PDF URL remains available and matches the discovery fingerprint.
